use lib '{- sourcedir('util', 'perl') -}';
    use OpenSSL::fallback '{- sourcefile('external', 'perl', 'MODULES.txt') -}';

notes: PROJECT-MAINTAINED SOURCE ONLY. No upstream support or clang-cl/LLVM compatibility claim. No captured supplier code was executed or imported; no supplier postimage was materialized or patched in a source tree. All operation identities were computed using UTF-8 byte transformations in memory.

Apply each file operation sequentially to its original pinned member; every old string must occur exactly once at that point, then require post_bytes/post_sha256. Members are normalized after stripping the openssl-3.5.0 archive prefix. These are Source-resource instructions, not C factory or child-proof fields.

Configure includes the admitted 8f8c58f44edeae5899df0fb5e35911a5957678547cccb9bb39d01812f5e8dd48 private compiler-map replacement, extended with explicit no-apps/no-docs/no-tests/no-module/no-makedepend CLI and state guards, exact preprocessor/build-file values, and the original exact-target/noasm/VC-dependency/no-strict-warnings constraints. The generated release NDEBUG definition is accepted exactly once. HASHBANGPERL must be an explicit command binding equal to the exact H2 PERL binding; derived CPP must remain exactly $(CC) /EP /C.

The exact private target must occur literally in original argv. Its initial supplier configuration evaluation is limited to 00-base-templates.conf and 10-main.conf. OPENSSL_LOCAL_CONFIG_DIR is rejected; one absolute explicit --config path named foundation-amd64-static-noasm.conf is required and must independently match the admitted maintained Source config pin. Shared-info evaluation is omitted only after the private static/no-module guard; nonprivate source behavior is retained.

The admitted MODULES.txt body is exactly Text-Template-1.56/lib followed by LF (23 bytes, SHA256 252ffb41be0e0f03bcf489877e38115a2824de9e69ff17dd6c83897d19c1feb3). Configure prepends that bundled path in a private argv-conditioned BEGIN before OpenSSL::Template loads. Generated private configdata receives a target-conditioned use-lib before fallback, so fallback append order cannot select an ambient Text::Template first. Source-pinned Text/Template.pm remains a required executable input.

Private Configure checks close/rename and returns after producing configdata.pm, before its original immediate system invocation. The controller must verify and pin that generated script and every referenced Source input before launching it. Use a fresh controlled build directory and keep inputs stable throughout each child.

Private configdata CLI is exactly --foundation-stage=emit-template, or --foundation-stage=render-template followed by the admitted absolute build-directory makefile.in path. Emit closes makefile.in and exits; controller must rehash/pin it as strict-earlier generated executable template data before render. Render never writes that input, replays gentemplate into an in-memory scalar sink to restore its original state mutations, and retains same-process makefile-then-configuration.h fills with PACKAGE OpenSSL::safe. That package name is not an execution sandbox. For Windows separator spelling, the absolute render operand is canonicalized only for comparison with the expected build-directory path; its original admitted argument remains the template SOURCE.

The private generated script excludes the compile-time OpenSSL::Config::Query use by target-conditioned template output; its branch contains a private error instead. Runtime stage dispatch also rejects query/reconfigure/other modes. Nonprivate generated scripts retain the exact Query use. No Query-module stub or guessed import closure is supplied.

Configuration.h rendering is mandatory and remains in its original order. Its newly admitted 2085-byte template has SHA256 794fb8057df3ad5ff5da7e60d7d23e7492d994a7a2a52d7d20c5302a2699916b. The admitted 274-byte OpenSSL/Glob.pm has SHA256 4100606067f0b577d3e6d2d2aaca93d826fb66105639eb94ff76c70ae8c526c9. These and MODULES.txt are closed reviewed Source inputs, not outstanding gaps.

Remaining bootstrap-independent Source closure must be completed by the companion graph/resources: every selected subordinate build.info, actual generator/template input, mandatory generated header/C source, and native compile input must be admitted with its real bytes and dependency edges. This bootstrap resource does not invent missing bodies, suppress mandatory generation, or provide stubs. H2 tool/runtime identities, generated-output admission and actual native/consumer qualification remain separate requirements.

The no-makedepend profile is a fixed fresh-build route: source/build trees are fresh private controlled outputs, mandatory generation remains enabled, and no incremental-build or dependency-sidecar coverage is claimed.
